== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Dagobah-D-commchief-PC-Errata-2018-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Comm Chief (PC Errata 2017 slip)]] (31 May 2017): Same words. A full card image with the text box set again and a white italic “E” in the black lower border.

The 2017 slip and the same area of the 2018 image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
